rules.text:
How this is built

• A copy of the Member profile (1c desktop, 1j mobile): same shell, back link, identity header, next-action banner, tab bar with red dots, 1.55fr / 1fr cards, locked block.
• Nothing new behind it: permissions (none / view / edit / send / full), weekly hours + slots + Active, date exceptions, week assignments with + Assign / edit / remove, salary / per-class / hourly pay + bonuses, private lesson types, Setup link — existing staff features, now on one profile.
• Schedule & availability works the same for the owner (managing anyone) and for the staff member on their own profile.
• All times are 12-hour (AM/PM).
• Tab lives in the URL: ?tab=schedule. One Save per tab; leaving with unsaved changes asks first (in-app, never confirm()).
• Mobile 375: tabs scroll sideways, 44px targets, nothing under 12px, bottom sheets.

Every artboard is interactive — press Play.
